summary_md:
# Aktier på tilbud eller en fælde? Her vil to investorer slå til

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-11-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Børsen investor podcast covers a volatile AI and tech market. Nvidia jumped 31% in one day after the Jensen Huang CEO saga and Trump's apparent involvement, while the newly listed Anthropic slid below its IPO price. Guests Johnny Madsen and Peter Bækgaard prefer stable, defensive companies outside AI. Johnny names Demant as his favourite Danish stock, and Peter would only build a small position in Alphabet after a further sell-off. The hosts set Danske Bank's view that the dip is a buying opportunity against Lars Christensen's warning that US equities could fall up to 56%.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 DEMANT — Demant | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Johnny's favourite Danish stock after earnings season. He trimmed the overweight but keeps a core position and expects double-digit EPS growth for 5 years.

#### Reasoning

Guest Johnny Madsen: structural growth in hearing aids from ageing populations, longer lives and rising purchasing power. EBIT margin is recovering, there may be market share to win from a competitor merger, and cautious guidance leaves room to beat. At about 21x 2026 earnings it is not expensive. The catalyst may only come with the 2027 guidance in the annual report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the new product cycle fades as competitors launch
- if 2027 guidance disappoints
- if margin recovery stalls

> *"det er stadigvæk en, som jeg siger, det er et stort salg vinder i min optik"*

---

### 🟠 DEMANT — Demant | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Peter calls it a high-quality company with high ROIC and buybacks. He would buy on a setback and is watching the share price closely.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Bækgaard: 22x earnings is neither expensive nor cheap. Buybacks add 3-4% to EPS growth on top of 6-8% top-line growth. A rotation back into tech could create a buying opportunity.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hearing-aid sales cycle turns down

> *"Ja, det kunne jeg godt finde på, specielt hvis vi får et setback."*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Peter is tempted after the AI sell-off and would start with a 25% position if the market sells off hard.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Bækgaard: diversified revenue beyond AI (YouTube), its own chips that could compete with Nvidia, a history of adapting into leadership, CapEx funded from cash flow, and Berkshire's stake. He waits for a sharper market drop before buying.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it fails to gain a leading position in LLMs
- if CapEx can no longer be funded from cash flow

> *"For mit vedkommende er det relativt interessant."*

---

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Johnny and Peter see cyclical peak earnings in chip makers and uncertain five-year sales. Johnny expects the stock to be under pressure.

#### Reasoning

Guests: chip makers' EPS may have risen about tenfold in four years, which looks like an earnings bubble. Prices of technology tend to fall, and capacity build-up could bring a Maersk-style normalisation. Political intervention by Trump adds non-transparent risk. Host Simon, by contrast, expects it higher by year-end.

#### Sell Triggers

- if demand for AI chips proves durable with stable pricing

> *"den vil være under pres i et stykke tid nu"*

---

### 🟡 BIOG-B — BioGaia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Holding in the podcast portfolio. Peter calls the quarterly report excellent and is excited about the December capital markets day.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Bækgaard holds it in the portfolio game, praises the latest quarterly report and sees the December capital markets day as a catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the capital markets day targets disappoint

> *"jeg synes jo, deres kvartalsregnskab er fremragende"*

---

### 🟡 COLO-B — Coloplast | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Peter sold his trading position to raise cash but sees predictable earnings that are unlikely to halve in five years.

#### Reasoning

Guest Peter Bækgaard: a traditional company with visible earnings 3-5 years out. It was sold only as a trading position to free up cash for possible US tech buys.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth falls clearly below about 4-5%

> *"der skal ske meget for, at koloplastsalg halverer om 5 år"*

---
